anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a tool and specification for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, which is a technical method used for data curation and analysis.

anchors.paper_title: iEEG-BIDS, extending the Brain Imaging Data Structure specification to human intracranial electrophysiology
anchors.reason: The paper introduces iEEG-BIDS, a specification for storing and sharing iEEG data, which is a technical standard or method, not a paper describing the release of this specific dataset.

metadata.methods_description: Intracranial electrophysiological recordings were collected from patients during three listening tasks: movietrailers (Pixar, Disney, Dreamworks clips), timit4 (unique sentences from TIMIT corpus), and timit5 (10 repeated sentences from TIMIT corpus). Event markers indicate stimulus onset and offset. All procedures were approved by the University of Texas at Austin Institutional Review Board.
